items.title: Cigarette tin
items.content: An empty cigarette tin holding a few ordinary sewing needles.

items.title: Loose key
items.content: A brass key with no tag, found in a kitchen drawer. Its lock is unknown.

items.title: Broken fountain pen
items.content: A fountain pen with a cracked barrel. It no longer writes.

items.title: Spare radio dial
items.content: A loose Bakelite radio dial wrapped in a piece of newspaper.

items.title: Unpaired glove
items.content: A single wool glove, worn at the fingertips. No matching glove was located.

items.title: Matchbook
items.content: A nearly empty matchbook from a café. The last match is damp and unusable.

items.title: Cracked spectacles case
items.content: An empty spectacles case with a split hinge and no glasses inside.

items.title: Brass button
items.content: A single brass button in a sewing tin. It does not match the household coats nearby.

items.title: Pocket comb
items.content: A chipped pocket comb with several missing teeth.

items.title: Dull kitchen knife
items.content: A common kitchen knife with a worn wooden handle. It is clean and stored with the cutlery.

items.title: Broken alarm clock
items.content: A bedside alarm clock stopped at an unknown time. Its winding key is missing.

items.title: Tin toy car
items.content: A small tin car with one bent wheel, kept on a high shelf.

items.title: Empty perfume bottle
items.content: A small glass perfume bottle, dry and without a label.

items.title: Radio valve
items.content: A used radio valve in its cardboard sleeve. The glass is intact.

items.title: Worn pocket watch chain
items.content: A short watch chain without a watch, tangled around a drawer handle.

items.title: Darning needle case
items.content: A wooden needle case with two needles and a length of black thread.

items.title: Bent teaspoon
items.content: A teaspoon bent near the handle, stored with ordinary kitchen utensils.

items.title: Small padlock
items.content: A rusted padlock with no key. It opens under light pressure.

items.title: Worn leather wallet
items.content: An old wallet containing no money, only a few blank visiting cards.

items.title: Pocket mirror
items.content: A small pocket mirror with a cracked corner and a worn metal case.
